title: PCU John F. Kennedy First Fixed-Wing Aircraft Landing
description: Pre-Commissioning Unit John F. Kennedy conducts its first ever flight recovery operations involving fixed-wing aircraft while underway in the Atlantic Ocean, Oct. 13, 2026. John F. Kennedy is underway conducting Aircraft Compatibility Testing, which assess the operational capabilities of the ship's aircraft launch and recovery equipment with U.S. Navy aircraft. (U.S. Navy video by Mass Communication Specialist 1st Class Nolan Pennington, Mass Communication Specialist 1st Class Dean Cates, and Mass Communication Specialist Seaman Jayden Howard)
keywords: Salty Dogs Test and Experimental Squadron (VX) 23, fixed-wing aircraft, PCU John F. Kennedy (CVN 79), F-35 Lighning II, Gerald R. Ford-class
credit: Petty Officer 2nd Class Dean Cates, Petty Officer 1st Class Nolan Pennington, Seaman Jayden Howard
